title: Contents Packout & Storage Facility Schedule by Policy State
content:
Contents Packout & Storage vault storage follows the company's facility schedule by the policy state on the job's linked claim file. For the vault storage billed to the customer on a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job: **a policy state of FL carries the Florida facility factor, a policy state of LA carries the Louisiana facility factor, and any other policy state, or a job with no linked claim file, carries a facility factor of one.**

## Facility schedule

| Policy state on the linked Insurance Claim Services claim file | Facility factor |
|---|---|
| FL (Florida) | 1.15 |
| LA (Louisiana) | 1.08 |
| any other state | 1 |
| no linked claim file (for example a self-pay job) | 1 |

The state read is the policy state recorded on the Insurance Claim Services claim file the contents job is linked to, not the loss address and not the branch that handles the job.

## Cases (hypothetical rate per vault of 100.00)

- Linked claim file with policy state FL: the factor multiplies the rate to 115.00 per vault.
- Linked claim file with policy state LA: 108.00 per vault.
- Linked claim file with policy state TX, or no linked claim file: a factor of one, 100.00 per vault.
